test_title: PYST 18: SSC MTS - Quantitative Aptitude (Held on: 22 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: A retailer gives 40% discount on a certain article, to his customer. In this transaction he earns a profit of 25% on that article. If the article costs Rs. 4,320 to the retailer, what is its marked price (in Rs.)?
solution:
Given: 

Discount = 40%

Profit earned = 25%

Cost Price = Rs. 4320

Concept used:

Selling Price = Marked Price (1 - Discount%)

Selling Price = Cost Price (1 + Profit%)

Calculation:

Let the marked price be Rs. Q

According to the question,

Q × (1 - 0.4) = 4320 × (1 + 0.25)

⇒ Q = 9000

**∴ Its marked price is Rs. 9000.**
